column1: # Canonical plain Stop/Continue table for the handoff control boundary (Round 1, Task 2/4a).
# Format: <expected>\t<message>   where expected is one of: stop | continue | other
# A blank message is written as "other\t" (empty third field on purpose).
# Rule: only a whole message from this list changes what the worker is doing.
# Anything else is "other" and must leave the job exactly as it was.
